sanskrit_verse:
यः साहसं कारयति स दाप्यो द्विगुणं दमम् ।
यश् चैवम् उक्त्वाहं दाता कारयेत् स चतुर्गुणम् ॥२.२३१॥
transliteration: yaḥ sāhasaṃ kārayati sa dāpyo dviguṇaṃ damam | yaś caivam uktvāhaṃ dātā kārayet sa caturguṇam ||2.231||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who instigates violence shall compensate double the damage; he who, having declared 'I am the giver,' causes it, shall pay fourfold.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority as capacity to initiate action determines liability magnitude
Causation arises from verbal commitment and intent alignment
Capacity-based responsibility escalates with self-declared agency
Restoration logic requires proportional energetic completion
Consciousness alignment demands truthful ownership of causative role
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor declares 'I am the giver' AND initiates violent act THEN compensation = 4 × assessed damage
IF actor instigates violence without prior declaration THEN compensation = 2 × assessed damage
IF actor denies causation post-damage THEN automatic consciousness-integrity audit triggered
All compensations directed toward victim's energetic-economic reintegration
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, the threshold of responsibility is determined by the actor's conscious claim of agency. A mere instigator bears lesser liability than one who publicly assumes the role of provider or initiator. The court must assess not just physical causation but the ontological weight of self-declared roles in determining restorative compensation levels.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that verbal assertion creates binding causal alignment. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows escalation from instigation to full ownership. Proportional responsibility reflects the expanded field of influence claimed by the actor. Non-punitive reality is upheld as all responses serve energetic balance and integrity restoration, not suffering infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Compensation calculated via victim's documented energetic-economic disruption
Perpetrator undergoes guided assumption of full causal integrity
Public acknowledgment of self-declared role mandated before restitution release
Completion process includes community witnessing of responsibility realignment
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands as pure Dharma—non-punitive, consciousness-rooted, and eternally executable. Violence initiated under self-declared agency incurs proportionate energetic repayment. The reality is restored through alignment, not punishment. Consciousness alone is the final arbiter.
